text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I am walking past the Miho Dormitory
one day,
when I hear quite a commotion.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all! Anyth'n you could
ever
want, we've got!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Come t'take a look-see?
The Miho
Market's open to ev'ryone!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Yukino came up with the idea at
first, and
now it's a regular event here!
choice_data_list_en: A Miho Dorm local specialties fair?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We all get care packages from back
home, and
those usually come with
extras to share. Multiply
that by the
number of people stayin' here and it
can
get outta hand.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's a waste to just throw out all the
extras, so
Yukino suggested we set up a
market!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. We get tons of local staples from
around
the country, plus it's fun t'have
people from
outside the dorm come and
visit.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I used t'help out with a local market
back home,
so I figured I could pull it off
here too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It was really a brilliant idea. We can get
rid of our
excess stuff, and with
everyone from the academy
gathered, it
feels like a festival!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, go ahead and take a break,
Yukino!
I'll take care of everythin' while
the two of you
have a look around!
choice_data_list: 面白そうだし、見て行こうかな
choice_data_list_en: It looks fun, maybe I'll check it out before I go.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gather 'round, everyone! I’ve got all the
Edo
classics! Dorayaki, pepper flakes, 'n'
loads more!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
These look like they'd pair well with
green tea.
Can I get one of each?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll take some of that chili pepper! I
wanna try a
different kinda spicy from
my regular Salsa de la
Vida!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Bitter melon... This is a common
ingredient in
Chinese medicine. Should I
splurge on a few?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This Shisa dog key chain is super
cute! And
there's a pair of them, so
maybe I can give the
other to Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm sure she'd love it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Wind chimes... A gift that allows you to
feel close
to the wind. How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'll take this key chain! I saw a
huuuge one of
these in Fukushima!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That's called a wind sock. They're used
as
decorations for Tanabata.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm glad everyone seem t'be hav'n
fun!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing quite like the feel'n of a
good
market.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Course seeing all this stuff makes me
'ppreciate
my hometown more, but it's
also nice t'learn more
'bout where
ev'rybody else comes from.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My heart feels full t'burst seeing all the
love their
fam'lies put into their care
packages.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, I can see everyone else is
feel'n the
same fuzzy feel'n when I walk
around and look at
them. It makes me so
happy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I found the courage t'suggest
this idea to
Hishiama.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I found the courage t'suggest
this idea to
Hishiama.

choice_data_list_en: Let's go all out and have fun visiting the booths too!
Let's check out all the booths and have a blast too!
Your deep love for your hometown really shines through.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Great idea! Follow me! The Morioka
booth's real
close by!
choice_data_list: 俺たちも全力でブースを回って楽しもう！

choice_data_list_en: Let's go all out and have fun visiting the booths too!
Let's check out all the booths and have a blast too!
Your deep love for your hometown really shines through.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We've got crispy rice crackers and
sesame honey
rice dumpl'ns!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Not t'mention the big three Morioka
noodle
dishes! Well, there's no wanko
soba, but we've
got the other two!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just look'n at 'em reminds me how my
family used
t'eat them all the time when
the sun was really
beat'n down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although she's technically on break,
Yukino Bijin
walks me around the
booths, diligently explaining
what
everything is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As she continues to show me just how
much she
loves her home, I find myself
thoroughly enjoying
my time at the
market.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know! All the booths are so amaz'n, it's
hard
t'know where to start.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me! I wanna go t'your
hometown
someday!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Consider'n how warm and kind you are,
it must be
all kinds of swell!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo! I better hit the gym so I can hit
up all the
best spots and carry all the
souvenirs I'm gonna
buy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin smiles, and my heart fills
with her
warm, welcoming energy.
